verification_report.summary: The complete submitted proof is correct under the explicitly stated real-polyhedral conventions. All eleven proof items were checked sequentially, including their individual deductions and hypothesis use. The local convexity criterion tests every nonnegative relation, and the vertex mass uses the correct primitive-coordinate weighted slopes. Both tent perturbations preserve convexity, the obstacle bound, and admissible growth. The one-vertex counterexample, bounded-reference shift, nonsaturated tripod, subdivision argument, and trivalent consequence are valid. In the accessibility obstruction, the required positive rational vector exists, the compact slice attains its minimum, and relative-interior strictness preserves positive vertex mass. The supporting relation forces envelope contact with the modified function while leaving a strict obstacle gap. The classification then follows from non-accessibility and the rank-one contact argument. The edge-jet conditions are necessary and sufficient, including the strict secant inequalities, rational breakpoint construction, and finite linear feasibility reduction. The reference-mass corollary follows directly. The cited results were searched through search_arxiv_theorems first and then checked in the primary [BMPS26 paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.08664v1). Its envelope proof supports the stated real-affine extension; its convexity and Laplacian definitions agree with the applications after that explicit extension. No critical errors or gaps remain.
